# Stacked-PR restack, retarget and lease-push support

Status: needs-triage
Type: task
Blocked by: 04
Source: moor-95 retro, 2026-10-12 (rank 5)
Related: .groundwork/work/pre-release-hardening/tickets/03-stacked-prs-follow-up-motive.md (planning side: PH-17..PH-23)

## Owner rules

- Merge commits, not squash. Squash caused add/add conflicts down the stack.
- Update a child by rebasing it onto its parent and pushing with `--force-with-lease`. Never merge the parent into the child.
- When a parent merges and GitHub deletes its branch, retarget the child to main.

## Request

- A `gw stack` helper or skill that restacks, pushes with lease, retargets children and re-pins PR bodies (see 04). It refuses parent-into-child merges.
- git-master currently refuses every force-push, which conflicts with this owner-approved rebase workflow. Add a mode that allows `--force-with-lease` on owner-approved feature branches only. Never allow it on main or published history.

## Comments

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

2026-10-12, user decisions:
- Force-with-lease is allowed. git-master gets a mode for `--force-with-lease` on feature branches. Plain `--force`, and any push to the default branch, stay refused.
- Delivery: a skill script that supplements the `gh-stack` extension, not a new `gw stack` CLI. It lives in groundwork's PR skill. mattpocock-skills:pr is upstream and must not be edited, so the home is `groundwork:human-layer`, which already owns PR bodies and `pr-links.ts`. Confirm with the user if a separate groundwork `pr` skill is wanted instead.
- Before writing the script, check what `gh stack` already covers (restack, push, sync/retarget) and fill only the gaps: re-pin PR-body links after each restack (needs 04 `--repin`), refuse parent-into-child merges, and retarget the child to main after the parent merges, if gh-stack does not already do that.

2026-10-12, comparison (upstream pr vs human-layer vs gh-stack):
- The two conflict. Upstream `mattpocock-skills:pr` (description "Use when writing a PR body.") prescribes Summary/Evidence/Merge Danger. human-layer prescribes Summary/Why/Changes/Impact/Review focus/Proof. A body written to upstream fails human-doc-check. doc/upstream.md:31 marks upstream pr NOT USED, but that is doc-only and nothing stops it from auto-triggering.
- gh-stack already covers restack (`gh stack rebase`), lease push (`push`/`submit` use `--force-with-lease --atomic`), and partly covers retarget (sync+submit fix bases; there is no explicit retarget check). It does not cover refusing parent-into-child merges, a merge-strategy rule, or custom PR bodies (`gh pr edit` needed).
- Decision (user: "replace with our own pr skill if needed"): ship `groundwork:pr`, whose description says it supersedes mattpocock-skills:pr (same precedent as groundwork:implement). It covers opening, updating and restacking PRs. Body content comes from human-layer and the pr-body template; links come from pr-links (render plus `--repin`, ticket 04). The stack flow uses gh-stack, plus a script for the gaps: refuse parent-into-child merges, verify each child's base after a parent merges, and re-pin and `gh pr edit` bodies after each push. The merge-commit-not-squash rule goes in the skill. Update doc/upstream.md:31 to ALTERED/replaced and add a routing row.
